high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "finforall." The post features a graphic illustration of two hands holding a globe. The background of the image is a gradient of warm colors, transitioning from orange to a lighter shade at the bottom. The text accompanying the image reads: "These numbers are especially staggering when put in context. The bill for the war is almost 7 times more than the almost $330 billion cost quoted by the Guardian to end world hunger by 2030." Below the text, there are engagement icons for liking, commenting, and sharing the post.
